dynamic_line: This book contains the rituals allowing to obtain the components.  Each of them requires a complicated process to get.  I'm giving you this book so you won't come back asking for more information every two hours.
I do have another copy, however you'll have to buy it at a steep price.  Each of these are written by hand these days so we can't let people treat them like disposable things.

responses.text: I'll come back later for that.  See you.
